rows.text: copies 0x118-byte records one at a time from the range starting at `rcx` up to (not including) `rdx` into consecutive records starting at `r8` (two passes of eight 16-byte moves, then 16 bytes at `+0x100` and a qword at `+0x110`); returns `r8` advanced by 0x118 per record copied, or `r8` unchanged when `rcx` equals `rdx`

inserts `r8d` copies of the 0x118-byte record at `r9` before position `rdx` in the record array whose qwords `[rcx]`, `[rcx+8]` and `[rcx+0x10]` hold its start, end and limit: when `r8d` is above (unsigned) the room (limit minus end)/0x118 it allocates max(size + `r8d`, twice the size or 1 when empty) records through virtual slot `+0x10` of the object at `rcx+0x18`, fills the new block with the head, the copies and the tail through the calls at `0019E2C0` + 0x3AE, + 0x3CA and + 0x3F9, frees a non-null old block through slot `+0x18` of the same object and stores the new start, end and limit; otherwise, when `r8d` is non-zero, it copies the record to a local, and when the tail after `rdx` holds more than `r8d` records moves its last `r8d` records past the end (`0019E2C0` + 0x121), advances qword `[rcx+8]`, shifts the rest up (`0019E2C0` + 0x133) and fills the gap with the local copy; when the tail is not longer it writes the extra copies past the end, moves the tail behind them (`0019E2C0` + 0x29D), advances qword `[rcx+8]` and fills the old tail positions; returns at once when `r8d` is 0

calls `0019EA20` + 0x22 with (`r8`, qword `[rcx+8]`, `rdx`) and `0019EA20` + 0x31 with (`rcx`, that result, qword `[rcx+8]`), then subtracts (`r8` minus `rdx`) taken in whole 0x130-byte records from qword `[rcx+8]`; returns `rdx`

returns at once when `rdx` is null; otherwise, for the node `rdx` and then each node reached through its qword `+8` until that is null, calls itself with (`rcx`, qword `[node]`), resets the two string buffers at node `+0x40` and node `+0x20` (when a buffer's qword `+0x18` is 0x10 or more it frees its qword `+0` through `001A49C0` + 0x8F or + 0xF1, and when that qword `+0x18` plus one is 0x1000 or more it frees instead the qword stored just before the pointer after checking that the pointer is 32-byte aligned and lies 8 to 0x27 bytes above it, any failed check calling through qword `008C2DA8`; it then stores 0xF at `+0x18`, 0 at `+0x10` and byte 0 at `+0`) and calls virtual slot `+0x18` of the object at `rcx+0x30` with (that object, node, 0x60)

calls `001AAE70` + 0x19 with (`rcx`, qword `[rcx]`, qword `[rcx+8]`); then, when qword `[rcx]` is non-null, calls virtual slot `+0x18` of the object at `rcx+0x18` with (that object, qword `[rcx]`, (qword `[rcx+0x10]` minus qword `[rcx]`) taken in whole 0x30-byte records), and otherwise returns without it

walks the 0x30-byte records from qword `[rcx]` (count (qword `[rcx+8]` minus qword `[rcx]`)/0x30, recomputed each pass) and, for each whose byte `+0x28` is non-zero, copies qword `+8` to qword `+0x10`; then, for each record from qword `[rcx]` below qword `[rcx+8]` whose qword `+8` is non-null, calls virtual slot `+0x18` of the object at record `+0x20` with (that object, qword `+8`, (qword `+0x18` minus qword `+8`) AND ~7); finally stores qword `[rcx]` into qword `[rcx+8]`

when qword `[rcx+8]` is below (unsigned) qword `[rcx+0x10]`, advances qword `[rcx+8]` by 0x30 and, when the old value `E` is non-null, copies dword `[rdx]` to `E`, word `[rdx+4]` to `E+4`, calls `001AD0C0` + 0x4C with (`E+8`, `rdx+8`) and copies byte `[rdx+0x28]` to `E+0x28`; otherwise calls `001AD0C0` + 0x60 with (`rcx`, qword `[rcx+8]`, `rdx`)

returns without work when `edx` is not above (unsigned) (qword `[rcx+0x10]` minus qword `[rcx]`)/0x30; otherwise calls `001B1A20` + 0x4F with (`rcx`, `edx`, qword `[rcx]`, qword `[rcx+8]`), frees a non-null old qword `[rcx]` through virtual slot `+0x18` of the object at `rcx+0x18` with (that object, old start, the old limit distance in whole 0x30-byte records), and stores the returned pointer `N` at qword `[rcx]`, `N` plus the old (end minus start) in whole 0x30-byte records at qword `[rcx+8]` and `N` + `edx`*0x30 at qword `[rcx+0x10]`

returns when dword `[rcx+0x20]` is 0x80 or more (signed); otherwise reads qword `01F81880`[dword `01F81834`*0x80 + dword `[rcx+0x20]`] and, when it is non-null, calls virtual slot `+0xE0` of the object in qword `01F81840` with it as `rdx` and then sets dword `01F81850`[dword `01F81834`] to 1 if it was 0; in both cases increments dword `[rcx+0x20]`
tail-jumps through `001FB830` + 0xA with `rcx` = qword `01F7F4D0` and `rdx` = qword `[rcx]` of the incoming `rcx`

clamps `edx` to 0 through 0x1FF (signed) and, in the 0x288-byte record `02098E10` + `ecx`*0x288 (sign-extended), sets bit (`edx` AND 0x1F) of dword `+0x244` + (`edx` >> 5)*4 when `r8d` is non-zero, or clears that bit when `r8d` is 0

with `B` = qword `02EBA508` and the 10-byte entry `E` = `B`+0x10+`ecx`*10, returns 0 when `B` is null, when `ecx` is greater (signed) than byte `B+4`, or when `edx` is not below (signed) the little-endian word `E+8`; otherwise takes the 24-bit little-endian value at `B` + dword `E+0` + 3*(`edx`/16, signed) shifted right by 2, adds for each of the `edx` minus 16*(`edx`/16) dwords from `B` + dword `E+4` + (`edx`/16)*64 either its bits 1 to 13 (bit 0 clear) or ((value >> 2, read as 0 when it is 0x3FFFFFFF) + 0x7FF) >> 11 (bit 0 set), and returns the sum plus dword `02EBA500`

takes `O` = qword `+0x320` of the qword pointer at `0209AC30`; when `O` is non-null, `ecx` is 0 and bit `0x2` of dword `O+0x570` is clear, calls `00561280` + 0x29 with `O` and sets that bit; when `O` is non-null, `ecx` is non-zero and the bit is set, calls `00561280` + 0x47 with `O` and clears it; on every other path (`O` null, or the bit already in that state) calls `00561280` + 0x61 with (1, 3) and tail-jumps through `00561280` + 0x72 with (0, 3)
calls `00616210` + 0x9 with the incoming register arguments unchanged, then stores the fifth to ninth (stack) arguments as dwords at `rcx+0x20`, `+0x24`, `+0x28`, `+0x2C` and `+0x30`; returns `rcx`

with `R` = `rcx`+0x708 when `edx` is 0 (else `rcx`+0x760), `k` = dword `rcx+0x6F0`, `S` = the sum over the `r9d` 0x88-byte records at `r8` of dword `+0x78` rounded up to a multiple of 16, and `F` = dword `+0x70` of the fifth (stack) argument `P` rounded the same way (0 when `P` is null): returns 0xD when dword `R`+0x20+`k`*4 plus `S` is above dword `R+0x30`, or dword `R`+0x28+`k`*4 plus `F` is above dword `R+0x34` (unsigned); otherwise, for each record whose dword `+0x78` is non-zero, stores qword `R`+`k`*8 at a 0x48-stride entry (index dword `+0x18`) of the area picked by dword `+0x20` (qword `+0x28` when its low 31 bits are above 1, the record's own `+0x28` when they are 1, null when 0), sets bit 0 of dword `+0x74` when that qword is non-null, stores the running offset at dword `+0x70` and, at qword `+0x80`, qword `rcx`+0x740+`k`*8 plus that offset (`edx` not 1) or 1 (`edx` 1, which also stores qword `rcx`+0x798+`k`*8, or 0 for an empty record, at entry `+0x10`); `P` is treated the same way with fields 8 lower, qword `R`+0x10+`k`*8 and `rcx`+0x750 or +0x7A8; it then writes both advanced offsets back and returns 0
stores the pointer `00D68DF0` at qword `[rcx]`, zeroes qwords `+8`, `+0x18`, `+0x28` and dwords `+0x10`, `+0x20`, `+0x30`, and returns `rcx`

notes: 0019E2C0: the room, size and tail counts use the 0x0EA0EA0EA0EA0EA1 multiply as a signed divide by 0x118; the realloc path copies from `r9` directly (no local copy); byte [rsp+0x190] (the caller's r8 home slot) is passed as the fifth argument of each move call and is not described. 0019EA20: the multiply by 0xF9435E50D79435E5 is a negated signed divide by 0x130, so the add at 0019EA80 lowers qword [rcx+8]. 0061C920 (doubt): long body; the byte stores at record +0x1C and P+0xE (4 when the stored base-plus-offset qword is zero, else 0, because the cmovne reads the flags of the preceding add, not of the null test; 0 on the edx==1 path) are left out of the sentence; on the edx==1 path the entry +0x10 store and bit 0 of +0x74 happen for every record, including empty ones; P's dword +0x70 is rewritten with the rounded F. 001A49C0: 008C2DA8 is the import slot the eight failure sites call through; cited by its resolved address only because the listing names no function there.
